content.text: - MC fatal hereditary dz in White people in US · MCC severe chronic lung dz in younger adults · 1 in 25 White persons = carriers
→ ↓Cl  secretion → ↑Na & ↑H2O absorption across exocrine glands (entire body) → build up thick, viscous secretions
- CFTR gene on chromosome 7 - mut copy from each parent required - MC mut: ΔF508 (3 base-pair deletion → ⍉phenylalanine @ position 508)
- CFTR = membrane Cl channel → altered Cl & H2O transp @ apical epithelium → ↑viscosity secretions (lungs · pancreas · liver · intestine · reprod tract)
- P. aeruginosa MC in recurr pulm infect → accelerated course
- resp: bronchiectasis · PNA · atelectasis · hemoptysis · cor pulmonale · resp failure
- GI: meconium ileus · meconium peritonitis · volvulus · intestinal atresia · hepatic steatosis · appendicitis · pancreatitis
↓prognosis w: prenatal meconium peritonitis · preterm birth · ↓birth wt
- death ← pulm comps or terminal chronic resp failure w cor pulmonale
ddx Huntington dz: AD - progressive neurodegen · MC presents 30-50y · chorea

ddx Marfan syndrome: AD - tall thin build · disprop long extremities · hyperflexible joints · pectus carinatum/excavatum · ↑risk spont pneumothorax · lens dislocation · aortic aneurysm/dissection · MVP
ddx fragile X · Rett syndrome: X-linked dom - affected mother → ≥50% of children · affected father → all daughters · ⍉sons
ddx muscular dystrophy: X-linked recessive - dystrophin gene mut · Gower sign - also X-linked recessive: red-green color blindness
Prenatal US: hyperechogenic bowel ± meconium peritonitis · bowel dilatation · ⍉gallbladder
(bowel obstruct) - often presenting Sx in NB
•MC Sx in children: chronic cough · wheezing · FTT
PE: apical crackles · ↑AP chest diameter · clubbing · hyperresonance (cyanosis ⍉common · dullness = consolidation, ⍉CF)
- older children: poorly controlled asthma · recurr resp infect (staph · pseudomonas) - clubbing · nasal polyposis
- ddx ABPA: hypersensitivity rxn to Aspergillus in CF airway or poorly controlled asthma
· diarrhea - bulky · pale · foul-smelling stools = pancreatic insuff
•pancreatitis ↑risk w pancreatic sufficiency - rare w pancreatic insuff
•pancreatic insuff: edema · hypoproteinemia · steatorrhea · insulin resistance · lyte loss · anemia
•panopacification of paranasal sinuses in 90-100% >8mo - nasal polyps → consider CF
Newborn screen (required in US) → (+) → sweat Cl test = definitive dx
•early detection → improved outcomes · ↓mortality - ⍉detected at birth → dx if clin Sx or sibling dx + evidence of CFTR dysfun
•admin pilocarpine (cholinergic drug → sweating) - quantitative pilocarpine iontophoresis sweat test = gold strd (measures Na & Cl)
•(+) = Cl ≥60mmol/L on 2 occasions - Cl ≥60 + clin dz in ≥1 organ system strongly suggests CF
•clin feature (chronic pulm dz · GI/nutritional abnorm · salt loss syndromes · obstructive azoospermia) + ↑sweat Cl or DNA (2 CF mut) or nasal potential difference testing
•declining lung funct → hypoxemia · resp acidosis - PFTs & ABG also monitor progression
: after sweat test → confirm dx & genotype for targeted tx - ↓accurate b/c many mut types ⍉tested w genotyping
Tx goals: clear & ↓lower airway secretions · reverse bronchoconstrict · tx resp infect & airway bact burden · pancreatic enzymes · nutritional & psychosocial support
ROSH: ⍉cure - tx directed at pulm & GI comps
↑dose Ibuprofen: ↓inflam in lungs → slows airway damage & dz progression
acute exacerbations: inhaled β2 agonists & corticosteroids - ⍉used as maintenance
new med: Ivacaftor (CFTR modulator) - ↑Cl transp w certain CFTR mut (approved mut only)
•empiric abx = antipseudomonal - persistent P. aeruginosa: inhaled tobramycin · azithro
•bronchodilator b4 chest PT & inhaled hypertonic saline - also mild pulm dz
•inhaled recombinant human DNA (DNase): breaks down lrg amounts of DNA in resp mucus that clogs up airway
•Vit supp (ADEK) - best initial intervention for pancreatic insuff · ⍉docusate (stool softener) · ⍉loperamide (antidiarrheal)
•lung transplant - only definitive tx for end-stage lung dz (⍉cure for CF)
